phase: First playable MVP achieved; research continues, competitive quality unproven
source_of_truth: docs/model-atlas: catalog, controls, saved receipts, map comparisons and extraction work queue

completed.title: First player-confirmed playable generated map - achieved 2026-10-25
completed.text: A saved map produced by the staged learned-terrain, learned-marker and learned-reclaim-allocation pipeline loads and is judged playable by the player. First playable proof of concept, not competitive certification or evidence that every generated map is playable.

completed.title: Map extraction and source representations
completed.text: Terrain/water, starts, resource markers, natural energy/mass, wrecks, civilians and surface material representations have source receipts. Unknown values and unsupported runtime rules remain explicit.

completed.title: Four selected generation stages
completed.text: Terrain/water, resource markers, natural reclaim allocation and wreck allocation have selected checkpoints. Deterministic finishing/composition exports geometry, markers and entities.

completed.title: Dataset and texture preparation
completed.text: The selected curated cohort contains 1,020 training and 97 validation maps. Texture extraction completed 1,117 maps with no decode failures; 929 albedo sources are fully resolved. Extraction success does not certify every shader’s training semantics.

completed.title: Gameplay-analysis and annotation pipeline
completed.text: Versioned route/front, resource-economy and air/drop analyses exist. The 3,108-version annotation-pool milestone reports 2,764 scored maps, 329 exclusions and 15 failures. These are heuristic 1v1 observations, not map-quality ground truth.

completed.title: Concluded all-in experiment: negative result
completed.text: One 73.3M-parameter model jointly predicted 13 source channels from noise and 12 ratings, on 782 train / 69 validation maps. About 9.10 measured GPU-session hours including diagnostics did not produce usable maps. The detailed report preserves methods, compute, figures and limits. Research is closed; no checkpoint is promoted.

completed.title: Navigable project atlas
completed.text: Five exact FAF map versions, 19 comparison families, source/method links, model contracts, archived runs, global preview sliders and explicit extraction TODOs now organize the project.

completed.title: Dataset audit in the atlas
completed.text: The 1x1, 10km tab preserves all 1310 maps from the original Full256 V3 audit collection, with exact membership, per-map source/derived/target previews, coverage filters, recorded curation, strategy/vault ratings, questions and shared owner-editable flags/notes. It does not approve maps or change membership.

completed.title: Experimental terrain-first symmetry sidecars
completed.text: All 1310 audit maps processed in 72.9 seconds: no failures, 1282 experimental geometry-gate passes, 28 provisional labels. Saved 28-value vectors and source correspondences are visible per map; selected models do not consume them. The cohort inherited a half-map compatibility filter, so this is not vault-wide prevalence.

completed.title: Human-readable symmetry diagrams and review catalogs
completed.text: All 1310 maps have named types, directional-gradient PNG patterns, transparent 512px overlays and annotated geometry diagrams. Mirrored copies preserve gradient direction; rotational copies rotate it; multiple axes add colors. 209 have review reasons; all 118 no-match maps have saved vault ranked=True, including 94 current curated maps. No-match is not confirmed asymmetry. EXTRACT-13 now records the proposed transform-aware, scenario-preserving path repair; the path algorithm itself is unchanged.

results: MapGen Heatmap Medium 303: player assessment - "This map is actually playable. Not good, but also not terribly bad and IS playable." Frozen presentation export preserved; no claim of competitive certification.
Selected terrain geometry and natural reclaim composition have been observed in game; resource markers were exported and playtested, with balance still unproven.
Wreck allocation is trained and exported, but its current runtime behavior is not yet verified.

The joint one-map baseline reproduced a spatial template (height correlation 0.9980 at update 2,365), while sparse-density totals remained badly biased (Start A integral 139.6 instead of one). This is memorization evidence, not generalization.

The all-in research is closed with a negative full-generation result after 9.10 measured session hours and 667,632 map presentations. Lower LR avoided the old collapse through update 4,971, but fresh maps and quantity totals remained unusable. The complete report is in the atlas.
planned: Preserve the first playable demonstration while further research and training-data improvements proceed; no new training is scheduled by the milestone.

Owner decisions: EXTRACT-07 symmetry is the first priority, including multiple reflection axes and radial sectors, model encoding and source-start correspondence. EXTRACT-05 slope is accepted with implementation pending. See docs/model-atlas/maps-data-gap-plan.md and docs/model-atlas/extraction-work.json. Experimental terrain-symmetry sidecars now cover 1,310 audit maps; scientific review, start-pair policy and loader integration remain pending. No new training was started.
Solidify the current 10x10 km / 1v1 dataset as a named, versioned release with field readiness, non-square size classification and explicit validity; working name/ID are not a newly frozen dataset.
Inventory settings and declared/effective defaults for every dataset map; later configured resource-poor/rich examples may support static-map training. Generated adaptive maps remain out of scope.
Research a separate special-effects tensor with IDs/positions and supported parameters. Effect heatmap encoding is deferred.
Access rules, connected battle paths, economy-zone/contestability definitions and air scoring are deferred difficult work after symmetry. Team games are postponed; current scope is 1v1.

Specific atlas-map extraction reruns are out of scope. Additional augmentation is low priority; the terrain trainer already uses quarter-turn rotations/reflections, while pixel shifts require future validation.
Joint-source research is concluded for now; possible representation/objective changes are documented hypotheses, not scheduled training.
Learned texture painting, civilian composition and spawn-layout generation remain planned or experimental, with exact boundaries in the catalog.
Continue structuring completed work and the TODO list in this atlas; validate exports and gameplay rather than equating loss with playability.

update_contract: Progress must be recorded in the atlas, then published as a GitHub codex/atlas-live snapshot. Open pages check for a newer snapshot every 60 seconds. Uncommitted local work is not automatically visible.
